subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be resolved narrowly by the heartbeat `session` precedence fix, or should it also change the documented default Telegram DM-to-main routing behavior?
rationale: Current source proves the heartbeat precedence bug, while current docs and tests still intentionally default Telegram DMs to the main session unless `dmScope` isolates them.

options.title: Land narrow heartbeat fix
options.body: Adopt, rebase, or replace the linked implementation so configured heartbeat sessions win for system-event-triggered wakes, while leaving Telegram default DM policy unchanged.

options.title: Split DM default policy
options.body: Keep this issue focused on heartbeat session pollution and open or link a separate product issue for changing Telegram DM default isolation.

options.title: Close as intentional defaults
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the current `dmScope` docs and workaround are sufficient and the heartbeat-session precedence path no longer needs a code fix.

recommendation.title: Land narrow heartbeat fix
recommendation.body: Adopt, rebase, or replace the linked implementation so configured heartbeat sessions win for system-event-triggered wakes, while leaving Telegram default DM policy unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame points to Vincent Koc across the central heartbeat, exec, Telegram routing-test, and docs surfaces involved in the decision.
